# Transcriptomics

Preserve the requested method, contrast, identifiers, enrichment source, and
statistical population. These are parts of the estimand, not interchangeable
output formats.

## Differential Expression

- Match count-matrix sample IDs to metadata before fitting. Confirm the design
  formula, covariates, reference and target levels, and contrast direction.
- Use raw counts for count-model methods unless the named method specifies a
  different input. Do not treat normalized or transformed abundance as counts.
- Use the matched experimental control. Do not replace a vehicle, batch-matched,
  or paired control with another baseline unless the task defines that contrast.

for (f in c('inputs/res_1vs97.rds','inputs/res_1vs98.rds')) {
  x <- readRDS(f)
  cat('\\nFILE', f, '\\n')
  cat('class:', paste(class(x), collapse=','), '\\n')
  cat('dim:', paste(dim(x), collapse='x'), '\\n')

  print(metadata(x))
  cat('mcols:\\n')
  print(mcols(x))
  cat('attrs:', paste(names(attributes(x)), collapse=' | '), '\\n')
  ii <- grep('35160|PGD1656520|pumA', rownames(x), ignore.case=TRUE)
  cat('matches:', paste(ii, collapse=','), '\\n')
  if (length(ii)) print(as.data.frame(x[ii,,drop=FALSE]))
  cat('rownames first:', paste(head(rownames(x)), collapse=' | '), '\\n')
}

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
for (f in c('inputs/res_1vs97.rds','inputs/res_1vs98.rds')) {
 x <- readRDS(f)
 rn <- attr(x,'rownames',exact=TRUE)
 ld <- attr(x,'listData',exact=TRUE)
 em <- attr(x,'elementMetadata',exact=TRUE)
 emld <- attr(em,'listData',exact=TRUE)
 md <- attr(x,'metadata',exact=TRUE)
 cat('\\nFILE:',f,'\\n')
 cat('columns:',paste(names(ld),collapse=' | '),'\\n')
 cat('target index:',which(rn=='PA14_35160'),'\\n')
 i <- which(rn=='PA14_35160')
 for (nm in names(ld)) cat(nm,':',format(ld[[nm]][i], digits=15),'\\n')
 cat('column metadata names:',paste(names(emld),collapse=' | '),'\\n')
 for (nm in names(emld)) {cat('EM',nm,':\\n'); print(emld[[nm]])}
 cat('metadata names:',paste(names(md),collapse=' | '),'\\n')
 for (nm in names(md)) {cat('META',nm,':\\n'); print(md[[nm]])}
}
RS"
